I’m extremely disappointed with Four Paw. My cat was stung by a honeybee, and we took him there in an emergency. Unfortunately, they gave him the wrong medication, which made his condition much worse. It was heartbreaking to see my cat suffer because of their mistake.

Thankfully, we went to Supreme Clinic, where Dr. Vimal Pande treated him properly, and my cat was feeling so much better within just one day. The difference in care and professionalism was shocking.

I highly recommend avoiding Four Paw, even if their prices seem cheaper—it’s just not worth risking your pet’s health. Instead, go to Supreme Clinic, where your pets will get the right treatment and care they deserve.
